# OmniRevive-OS — Comprehensive Technical Specification (llms-full.txt)

> OmniRevive-OS is an autonomous, deterministic AI revenue recovery control plane designed for high-volume payment processing environments (UPI, Cards, Mandates, NetBanking) and enterprise B2B dispute reconciliation.

## System Architecture

### 1. Dual-Speed Control Plane Architecture
1. **Sub-50ms Fast-Loop Recovery Engine**:
   - **Diagnostic Latency**: P99 < 12ms.
   - **Autonomous Gateway Failover**: Real-time health scoring across banking switches (HDFC, ICICI, Axis, SBI).
   - **Dynamic UPI Intent Deep-Linking**: Instant fallback to alternate customer PSPs (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED).
   - **Weibull Hazard Survival Modeling**: Calibrated hazard curves scheduling smart retries at the empirical peak clearance interval (+45 minutes for network congestion).

2. **Deep-Loop Neural Voice & B2B Settlement Engine**:
   - **Deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM)**: Enforces strict state boundaries across 6 states (`GREETING`, `COLLECT_REASON`, `OFFER_TERMS`, `COLLECT_PTP`, `CONFIRMATION`, `TERMINATED`).
   - **Trilingual Speech Pipeline**: Real-time neural voice generation and speech-to-text in Telugu, Hindi, and Indian English.
   - **Semantic Qdrant Vector Memory**: Embeds and retrieves past dispute context, merchant transaction histories, and customer dispute dispositions.

### 2. Safety Invariants & Zero-Trust Governance
- **Atomic Idempotency Mutex**: Redis Compare-And-Swap (`SET key value NX PX ttl`) with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification guarantees exactly-once execution.
- **AWS Cedar Policy Engine**: Formal logic evaluation enforcing zero-trust boundaries on high-value interventions (> ₹50,000 INR), discount caps (< 10%), and role permissions.
- **TRAI Quiet-Hours Compliance**: Built-in statutory quiet hours enforcement (9:00 PM to 9:00 AM IST) deferring automated customer outreach to 9:05 AM IST next business day.
- **Sequential SHA-256 Merkle Audit Ledger**: Every transaction failure, diagnosis, intervention, and state mutation is cryptographically signed and chained in an immutable audit ledger.

### 3. Empirical Recovery Benchmarks
- **Test Suite**: 100-case held-out production test bench covering 7 major failure categories (Insufficient Funds, Gateway Outages, Bank Throttling, Expired VPA, 2FA Timeout, Network Glitch, Dispute Mismatch).
- **OmniRevive-OS Net Recovery Rate**: **78.39%**.
- **Industry Baseline Recovery Rate**: **42.24%**.
- **Net Recovery Uplift**: **+36.15%**.
- **Double-Debit / Idempotency Violations**: **0 (0.00%)**.
- **TRAI Regulatory Compliance**: **100%**.

## Key API Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/recovery/simulate`: Ingests and executes the 6-stage autonomous recovery pipeline on failed transactions.
- `POST /api/v1/voice/generate`: Real-time multilingual neural speech synthesis.
- `GET /api/v1/benchmarks/run`: Executes the 100-case empirical benchmark test suite.
- `GET /api/v1/audit/ledger`: Retrieves and verifies the sequential Merkle audit chain integrity.
- `POST /aws/cedar/evaluate`: Formal AWS Cedar security policy verification.
- `GET /api/v1/analytics/roi`: Computes merchant recovery yield, payback duration, and saved GMV margins.
